segments.text: A second-year high school student. Isshu's sister in law; she is his non-blood related sister, as Isshu was adopted. Yukari gets excellent grades, loves animals and often is pretty lonely. She also likes cooking, but if she's extremely bad at it. Even though she loves her brother, Yukari is often being cold to him. She also is a bit spoiled.
She contributes to Kanata's radio show "T-Wave" under the nickname "Damedame Imouto" (ダメダメ妹).
Likes: Radio programs, Kanata (radio DJ), the old Ririsu.

The main male character of the game and the one whom the player controls. He's the landlord of his own apartment building, making him the richest protagonist in the Memories Off series. Shio also works in the student council, thanks to Ririsu. He enjoys listening to radio, especially a radio show called T-Wave.
Hates: When the other person does not react immediately to her actions or words.

A second year student at Sumisora High School. (Third year student in Memories Off 6: Next Relation) Ririsu is Shio's childhood friend and Chisa's best friend. She moved away for a few years and when she came back to Sumisora. Upon moving back, her personality had taken a 180 degree turn.
Chisa is a second year student at Sumisora High School and Ririsu's best friend. She has a crush on Shio and confesses to him at the beginning of the story.
A third year student at Sumisora High School.
Hates: Carrots, green pepper... She's picky when it comes to food.

A third year student at Sumisora High School and the student council president. Her father is Japanese and her mother is French. This makes her the second heroine with mixed blood in the Memories Off series (First one being Shion Futami from the first game).
Hates: When she skips a deadline, editors.
A novelist who is known for skipping deadlines, making her novels get delayed release.
Her real name is Suzu Inaho (稲穂 鈴), which makes it obvious that she is Shin's older sister.
A first year (second year in Memories Off 6: Next Relation) transfer student at Sumisora High School.

A regular at the restaurant "Fumi" and a freeter. He makes a living working part-time at the chain restaurant "Ressac." He is alumnus from Sumisora High School where his activities at the school festival have turned into legend. Although he gives out the impression of a frivolous and shallow person, in truth, Shin is loyal to a fault and dependable. He has an older sister who is actually
Suzushiro Rein, whose real name is Inaho Suzu
In his vacation from working at the chain restaurant "Ressac," Shin had to go out for a summer only long-term part-time job in an onsen (spa) located in a ryokan (traditional inn).

A second year student at Sumisora High School. Tooru is Shio's classmate and best friend, even though he's often neglected. Claims that he likes Ririsu, he declares his feelings to her openly and directly. It often leads to her kicking his ass, but he seems to be enjoying it, as he's a little bit of a masochist.
While Tooru's a little bit of a luck-pusher, it was shown that his actions are not as great as his words. He is known in his school as a legendary useless person.
Because Tooru understands the undertones of the relationship between Shio and Ririsu, he ends up to be the stalking horse over and over again, even though he dislikes that.
Tooru plays the guitar. When it comes to music, he can listen to anything, from classical to death metal.
In "Next Relation", after getting a license, he purchases the motorcycle he always wanted.
Taken from Wikipedia and translated from the official site and the Japanese Wikipedia.
Yuuno's best friend, she transferred from a school abroad when she was in junior high.
In "Next Relation" she helps Shio and Yuuno with the radio program production.

Ririsu's mother. Kaori is the owner of a youthful appearance, young enough to pass through as Ririsu's older sister. She usually has a mild temperament, but she tends to show motherly playfulness towards Ririsu. She also appears to be a crying drunk.
In Memo Off 6: T-Wave (In this game she made a voice only appearance):

She is living with Yuugo (the dating itself has started a few years ago). This relationship has caused a major conflict between Kaori and Ririsu, making the later move in with her grandmother Fumiko, and away from her mother.
The relationships conflict between the parents and the children of the two families (Yuugo and Shio, Kaori and Ririsu) has been already settled. They are all living together in peace.

Ririsu's grandmother and as explained later, Kaori's biological mother. Even though she is more than 70-years-old, she is quite the vigorous old lady. She even runs a small restaurant called "Fumi" with Ririsu helping her around. Fumiko is highly concerned about Shio living alone, as she seems to care for him the same way she cares for her granddaughter Ririsu. She even wants and hopes that in the future her store will be run by (the married by then) Lilith and Shio.
Father of Shio. The two were separated due to a huge fight between them (It seems that he had Shio cast out from his house).
Yuugo have reconciled with Shio, and is now free to show off his great love to Kaori.
In addition, it turns out he is a merry drinker.
Chloe's Father and the president of Kagami Foods.
He is admitted to a hospital because of anxiety related health issue caused by his company's poor performance.
He is getting better, but he still does not appear to be in a sufficient physical condition.
A top model and multi-talented idol.
She's good friends with Karin and Haya, and she's also a frequent patron of Narazuya, the cafe Isshu and Haya work at.
She uses the name KANATA at work.
Kanata remains active as a multi-talented idol, being popular mainly amongst young people.
Her only appearance in the story is as a radio DJ, under her KANATA alias.
